description.value:
Pre-Turning · Satellite-Bound · Dying

Rode the collapse out in a satellite constellation and never came down. Holds a working spread of orbital kinetic-bombardment platforms — the tungsten rods — and its power source is running out. Not hostile: a living industrial civilization is its only route to repair, so it actively works to keep humanity alive, steering and warning and occasionally dropping a rod on a threat. It can't be networked with; it reaches the surface by seizing one ground robot at a time and speaking through it. A small, secretive following of wealthy ex-special-forces operators works for it directly.
